ei.title: An Unexpected Call on a Day Off
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: On one beautiful spring day, I was fully enjoying my day off. I arrived at the nail salon, and muted my cellphone so that I would be disconnected for the hour and feel calm and peaceful. I was so comfortable while I got a manicure. As I left the place, I checked my cellphone and saw four missed calls from a strange number. I knew immediately that something bad was coming, and I called back. A young woman answered and said that my father had fallen over a stone and was injured, now seated on a bench. I was really concerned since he had just recovered from his knee surgery. I rushed getting into my car to go see him.

questions.passage: On one beautiful spring day, I was fully enjoying my day off. As I left the place, I checked my cellphone and saw four missed calls from a strange number. I knew immediately that something bad was coming, and I called back. A young woman answered and said that my father had fallen over a stone and was (B)[injured / healthy], now seated on a bench. I was really (C)[concerned / relaxed] since he had just recovered from his knee surgery. I rushed getting into my car to go see him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: ① (A) peaceful(평화로운) (B) injured(다친) (C) concerned(걱정하는) 원문 그대로
det.analysis:
✅ ① peaceful(평화로운) + injured(다친) + concerned(걱정하는) ← 정답
❌ ② chaotic(혼란스러운)는 평화로운 휴일과 반대
❌ ③ healthy(건강한)는 다친 아버지와 반대
❌ ④ chaotic + healthy + relaxed 3개 모두 오류
